sn3.25:1.2: nisinnaṃ kho rājānam Pasenadi-kosalam Bhagavā etad avoca || ||
sn3.25:1.4: Yāni tāni bhante raññam khattiyānam muddhāvasittānam issariyamada-mattānaṃ kāma-gedha-pariyuṭṭhitānaṃ janapadatthāvariyappattānam mahantaṃ pathavīmaṇḍalam abhivijiya ajjhāvasantānaṃ rāja-karaṇīyāṇi bhavanti || tesvāham etarahi ussukkam āpanno ti || || 4.
sn3.25:2.2: Idha te puriso āgaccheyya puratthimāya disāya saddhāyiko paccayiko ||
sn3.25:2.4: yagghe mahārāja jāneyyāsi || aham āgacchāmi puratthimāya disāya ||
sn3.25:2.5: tatth-addasaṃ mahantam pabbataṃ abbhasamam sabbe pāṇe nipphoṭento āgacchati ||
sn3.25:2.6: yaṃ te mahārāja karaṇīyaṃ taṃ karohīti || || 5.
sn3.25:2.7: Atha dutiyo puriso āgaccheyya pacchimāya disāya || la ||
sn3.25:2.8: Atha tatiyo puriso āgaccheyya uttarāya disāya ||
sn3.25:2.9: Atha catuttho puriso āgaccheyya dakkhiṇāya disāya saddhāyiko paccayiko ||
sn3.25:2.11: yagghe mahārāja jāneyyāsi aham āgacchāmi dakkhiṇāya disāya ||
sn3.25:2.12: tattha addasam mahantam pabbatam abbhasamam sabbe pāṇe nipphoṭento āgacchati ||
sn3.25:2.13: yaṃ te maharāja karaṇīyam taṃ karohīti || ||
sn3.25:2.14: Evarūpe te maharāja mahati mahabbhaye samuppanne dārune manussakkhaye dullabhe manussatte kim assa karaṇīyan ti || || 6.
sn3.25:3.1: Evarūpe bhante mahati mahabbhaye samuppanne dāruṇe manussakkhaye dullabhe manussatte kim assa karanīyam aññatra dhammacariyāya samacariyāya kusalakiriyāya puññakiriyāyā ti || || 7.
sn3.25:4.1: Ārocemi kho te mahārāja paṭivedemi kho te mahārāja || adhivattati kho tam mahārāja jarāmaraṇaṃ ||
sn3.25:4.2: adhivattamāne ca te mahārāja jarāmaraṇe kim assa karaṇīyan ti || || 8.
sn3.25:4.3: Adhivattamāne ca me bhante jarāmaraṇe kim assa karaṇīyam aññatra dhammacariyāya samacariyāya kusalakiriyāya puññakiriyāya || || 9.
sn3.25:4.4: Yāni pi tāni bhante raññam khattiyānaṃ muddhāvasittānam issariyamada-mattānaṃ kāma-gedha-pariyuṭṭhitānaṃ janapadatthāvariyappattānam mahantam pathavi-maṇḍalam abhivijiya ajjhāvasantānam hatthi-yuddhāni bhavanti ||
sn3.25:4.5: tesam pi bhante hatthi-yuddhānam natthi gati natthi visayo adhivattamāne jarāmaraṇe || || 10.
sn3.25:4.6: Yāni pi tāni bhante raññaṃ khattiyānam muddhāvasittānam || pe ||
sn3.25:4.10: tesam pi bhante patti-yuddhānam natthi gati natthi visayo adhivattamāne jarāmaraṇe || || 11.
sn3.25:4.11: Santi kho pana bhante imasmiṃ rājakule mantino mahāmattā || ye pahonti āgate paccatthike mantehi bhedayituṃ ||
sn3.25:4.12: tesam pi bhante manta-yuddhānam natthi gati natthi visayo adhivattamāne jarāmaraṇe || || 12.
sn3.25:4.13: Saṃvijjati kho pana bhante imasmiṃ rājakule pahutaṃ suvaṇṇam bhūmigatañ c-eva vehāsaṭṭhañca yena mayam pahoma āgate paccatthike dhanena upalāpetuṃ ||
sn3.25:4.14: tesam pi bhante dhana-yuddhānam natthi gati natthi visayo adhivattamāne jarāmaraṇe || || 13.
sn3.25:4.15: Adhivattamāne ca me bhante jarāmaraṇe kim assa karaṇīyam aññatra dhammacariyāya samacariyāya kusalakiriyāya puññakiriyāyā ti || || 14.
sn3.25:5.1: Evam etam mahārāja evam etam mahārāja
sn3.25:5.2: adhivattamāne ca te jarāmaraṇe kim assa karaṇīyam aññatra dhammacariyāya samacariyāya kusalakiriyāya puññakiriyāyāti || || 15.
